scope: read-only performance and data-integrity source review of current integrated 16-screen app/test diff against origin/main
review_notes: Changed DUNE app code is chiefly adaptive SwiftUI presentation/layout and accessibility identifiers. W26 compact local History sheet preserves ExerciseHistoryView data and leaves other callers on their original NavigationLink path.
S03 changes focus and layout; existing Save and validation path is unchanged. W15, W25, W29/30, P02/P03/P08 changes do not add a model mutation or new database query path in the reviewed diff.

Existing ExerciseView schedulePickerAction has a Task.yield loop, but its only current caller synchronously sets showingExercisePicker=false immediately before scheduling; no concrete hot loop occurs in that path. This is not a finding.
No original test method was removed from the five affected UI test files. Added W34 selectors are distinct from old W13 authoring selectors.

The selector never taps Generate and does not request actual AI generation or persist a template.
w34.gate: Eligible as first fresh dedicated W34 Phone/iPad normal/MAX validation, if execution budget and ownership allow; not proof that old W13/W14 picker failures are resolved.
